BlockingIoSchedulers
«调度器 · 阻塞I/O隔离»
- AtomicReference<Scheduler> JDBC
- AtomicReference<Scheduler> CACHE
- AtomicReference<Scheduler> STORAGE
- AtomicReference<Scheduler> EVENT
- AtomicReference<Scheduler> REMOTE
- AtomicReference<Scheduler> GENERAL
+ jdbc() : Scheduler
+ cache() : Scheduler
+ storage() : Scheduler
+ event() : Scheduler
+ remote() : Scheduler
+ general() : Scheduler
VirtualThreadBoundedExecutor
«虚拟线程执行器»
- int maxConcurrency
- Queue<Runnable> queue
+ submit(task)
+ offer(task) : boolean
code=0 表示成功（非 HTTP 200）\ntraceId 全链路追踪\n泛型 T 为业务数据载体
LogicalDeletion 枚举: NOT_DELETED(0)/DELETED(1)\n@SuperBuilder 构造\n领域实体继承此类
@SuperBuilder · implements Serializable\n@TableId 雪花算法\n@Version 乐观锁\n@TableLogic 逻辑删除\nPO 仅用于持久化，与 DO 分离
ThreadLocal + Reactor Context 双桥接\nSchedulers hook 自动传播\n租户作用域来自受信任认证上下文
六池隔离: jdbc(32) cache(4) storage(8)\nevent(2) remote(16) general(16)\n每池可配 virtual-threads=true\n禁止直接用 Schedulers.boundedElastic()
